import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*;\s*$")
literal = re.compile(r"\d+")
update = re.compile(r"\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    if literal.fullmatch(expression):
        values[name] = int(expression)
    else:
        match = update.fullmatch(expression)
        if match:
            variable, increment = match.groups()
            values[name] = (values[variable] + int(increment)) % 100

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
